Quae omnia accurate supradictus vir eo ordine eademque consequentia qua apud nos solos geruntur propria scriptura expressit. page.notes: Upper part of the page; the lower part is cut off and not transcribed. Marginal notes at the right are in italic type and are set against the lines of the text; the Greek words in the notes are transcribed as best read in Latin letters where the Greek is uncertain. The word "FIN" is set in widely spaced capitals and is taken as a closing word; it is treated here as a heading as printed. Some letters in the notes are doubtful, notably "Maxime" and "epitheiazoon". Library oval stamp and the Google watermark at the foot are not transcribed. Greek words in the entries are transliterated as printed in the scan (erriphtho, threskeuein, hupobolimaios, etc.); their Greek letters were not clearly legible here, so they are given as printed Latin-letter forms and may need checking.
